newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine August public sector deficit $203.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine August public sector deficit $203.4 mln.

text.p: Argentina's public sector deficit in August excluding revenue from privatizations was $203.4 million, a dramatic drop from the $833.6 million deficit in July, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
Including revenue from state-companies sell-offs, the deficit was $162.5 million, versus $833.6 million in July, when there was no privatization income.
Current revenue amounted to $3.95 billion, while current expenditure was $3.88 billion, leading to a financial surplus of $67.8 million.
In July the financial surplus was $666 million.
Tax revenue came to $2.18 billion compared to $2.10 billion.
